text:
maria: quick async standup — what I did / blockers / today

maria: Did: pushed kernel microtune patch (batchline heuristics) to staging; ran a small perf sweep for 1k/2k seqs. Noticed tail latency improvement on p50/p95 for short requests.
maria: Blocker: KV miss spike on canary nodes after the patch — looks like evictions increased when batch sizes hit 48+. Root cause still fuzzy.
maria: Today: instrument eviction counters + add a tiny prefetch window to the slot allocator; will run a full 6h bench tonight.

akash: saw the canary logs — thanks for the heads up. Can you drop the output of the eviction counter query?
akash: also can we rollback the batchline toggle quickly if the 6h run shows regressions? I can prep the rollback patch.

maria: @akash — yes, rollback toggle is in the patch (feature gate: batchline_dynamic=true). I'll keep it on staging only until the 6h run completes.

jon: quick thought — the allocator prefetch window helps but we might also be shadowing some cold shards into the hotset when batch sizes increase. Small suggestion: try lowering slot_steal_threshold from 0.75 -> 0.6 for the canary and re-run a 30m microbench.
jon: command I used locally: 
```
./bench_runner --model gpt-small --seq 1024 --clients 32 --duration 1800 --tag microprefetch-test
```
jon: That gave me a clearer miss-rate pattern.

sarah: If you're re-running the 30m, can you include the per-shard miss heatmap? Will help me correlate with the KV eviction traces in the dashboard.
sarah: Also pinging @bench-bot to re-run the seq-dist profile with 10k samples for the evening run.

bench-bot: scheduled: seq-dist-profile (10k samples) queued on infra-qa; expected run time 21:10 UTC. Artifact link: https://bench.redwood.internal/artifacts/4287654321/seq-dist.json
bench-bot: quick summary from last run: p50 tokens/ms improved ~6%, p95 improved ~3%, overall cost/token -0.8%. KV miss-rate increased from 0.9% -> 2.7% on canary nodes.

maria: perfect — thanks @jon @sarah. I'll lower the slot_steal_threshold on the canary and re-run the 30m microprefetch test this afternoon, then let the 6h sweep run overnight with the prefetch window toggled on.
maria: action items: 1) instrument eviction counters + expose per-shard heatmap (today) 2) lower slot_steal_threshold on canary and run 30m microbench (today) 3) night 6h full sweep (maria) 4) @akash prepare rollback patch and keep it staged (done)

akash: sounds good. If the bench shows >2% miss-rate we roll back and open a follow-up PR that adjusts prefetch sizing per shard.

jon: FYI I left a short code review on your PR (maria) around the batchline config defaults — nothing blocking, just a nit about the config docstring.

maria: thanks @jon — I'll address the docstring now.
maria: TL;DR for the channel — microtune patch looks promising for latency, KV eviction side-effect needs investigation; running targeted experiments today, will report results in morning sync. :thumbsup:

sarah: awesome, thanks. ping if you need extra infra to parallelize the microbench runs.

akash: +1.

bench-bot: note: the queued seq-dist-profile run will post results as a thread reply when complete.

maria: closing the loop here — will post the 30m microbench artifact link once ready.
